description: This file defines an abstract class 'Extension' used as a base for creating extensions in the OpenMRS system. It contains properties and methods related to extension points, media types, and associated metadata, facilitating dynamic and configurable UI or functionality extensions.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating extensions at specific points within the OpenMRS system UI or functionality. It manages extension point identifiers, module associations, parameters, media types, and provides utility methods for extension identification.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the extension with given parameters and sets the pointId.

methods.name: getPointId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the extension point this extension targets.

methods.name: setPointId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the extension point.

methods.name: getParameterMap
methods.description: Returns the map of parameters provided at the extension point.

methods.name: setParameterMap
methods.description: Sets the parameters map for this extension.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the media type supported by this extension.

methods.name: getExtensionId
methods.description: Constructs and returns a unique extension identifier based on pointId and media type.

methods.name: getOverrideContent
methods.description: Allows overriding the default content for the extension; default implementation returns null.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Returns the module identifier that implements this extension.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order priority for the extension; lower values appear first.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the extension instance.

methods.name: toExtensionId
methods.description: Static utility method converting pointId and mediaType into a string extensionId.
